headline: 貝葉掛毯抵達英國
context: 11 世紀的貝葉掛毯（Bayeux Tapestry）在最高安全規格下運抵英國：深夜過海峽、測試演練、防震框架全上。九月起在大英博物館展出，門票已在快速售出。

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: The 11th-century tapestry will go on display at the British Museum in September. Tickets for the exhibition have already been selling rapidly.
sources.title: Bayeux Tapestry Arrives in U.K. After Maximum-Security Operation

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Medieval artwork safely delivered to British Museum before going on display from September in tightly controlled conditions Bayeux tapestry crosses Channel in dead of night The Bayeux tapestry has survived myriad perils, from cathedral fires to its potential destruction for use as wagon covers. Now, with the embroidery about to be displayed in a blockbuster London exhibition , experts must contend with a host of more insidious dangers. The arrival of the tapestry at the British Museum in the small hours of Friday morning was a historic moment – albeit less dramatic than the landing of William the Conqueror it portrays. Continue reading...
sources.title: Test runs and a shock-absorbing cage: how Bayeux tapestry was moved to UK

thread_text:
11 世紀的貝葉掛毯（Bayeux Tapestry）運抵英國。這次搬運是最高安全規格：事前測試演練、防震框架、深夜橫渡英吉利海峽。掛毯九月起在大英博物館展出，門票已在快速售出。

本則整理自 The New York Times 與 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 10 日發佈的報導。
threads_text:
一件活過火災、差點被拿去當貨車篷布的 11 世紀文物，剛完成它最新的一次冒險。貝葉掛毯（Bayeux Tapestry）在最高安全規格下運抵英國：事前反覆測試演練、裝進防震框架、深夜橫渡英吉利海峽。九月起，它將在大英博物館展出——門票已經賣得飛快。

本則整理自 The New York Times 與 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 10 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 十一世紀的貝葉掛毯，安全抵達英國。這次搬運是最高安全規格：事前反覆演練、裝進防震框架、深夜橫渡英吉利海峽。這件文物歷經過大教堂火災，甚至差點被拿去當貨車篷布——現在，它九月起要在大英博物館展出，門票已經賣得飛快。
